items.title: Warren Buffett’s Coca-Cola Shares Now Pay Back Two-Thirds of What He Paid, Every Single Year
items.summary: Warren Buffett, 96, says Coke and McDonald's keep him going, and Coca-Cola pays Berkshire $848 million a year on 400 million shares bought for $1.3 billion between 1988 and 1994. Here is what that dividend math says for a 72-year-old widow with $1.6 million who inherited 4,000 Coke shares and is being told to buy more for the income.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Stock Faces Q3 Earnings Profit Decline Forecast
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway barely flinched after its latest report, with the stock easing just 0.01% on Friday even as fresh Q3 2026 numbers hit the tape. On the surface that muted move looks like a shrug. Underneath, it reflects investors weighing a very profitable quarter, with US$105.6b in revenue and US$22.1b in net income, against a longer runway where analysts now expect earnings to decline about 5.7% a year over the next three years. items.title: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A) Formalizes Greg Abel Succession After Earnings Slip And $9.6 Billion Repurchase
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (NYSE:BRK.A) reported weaker Q3 operating earnings as insurance results and investment income came under pressure. The group recorded a record US$9.6b share repurchase during the quarter, using a portion of its large cash balance. The board formalised the leadership shift, confirming Greg Abel as Warren Buffett’s successor in day to day oversight.
